usedFor: StoreHippo holds the shop's users and orders, and HubSpot receives them as contacts through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in StoreHippo, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new shop user becomes a HubSpot contact, matched by email so repeats update instead of duplicating.

watchOut: “Update Contact” works on an existing contact by email, so “New Order” only helps if the contact already exists.
